figures.alt: Warehouse office mezzanine with continuous guardrails, protected stairs, support columns, and enclosed office below
figures.caption: A structural mezzanine is an integrated package of supports, deck, stairs, guardrails, egress, services, fire-protection coordination, and the space below it.

figures.alt: Industrial warehouse concrete slab checked with laser level and straightedge across a normal localized floor joint
figures.caption: The existing slab and support locations need review before fabrication. Column bases, floor condition, operating clearances, equipment, and construction access can all shape the final mezzanine layout.

figures.alt: Institutional warehouse with high clear height, ESFR sprinkler infrastructure, high-bay lighting, wide grid, and dock doors
figures.caption: A mezzanine can change egress and fire-protection coordination. The final arrangement needs to be checked against the warehouse operations and the surrounding life-safety systems.
